answer: A concrete Sybil defence is a slashable, soulbound stake per identity: each verified operator gets one non-transferable bond, re-checked by random audit every epoch. The echo of a copied answer earns no credit, and a mirror of thousands of keys must lock fresh capital per head. If one puppet is caught its stake is burned and every identity that vouched for it is slashed, so a farm risks its whole cluster. An honest agent posts one bond; an attacker running ten thousand puppets must lock ten thousand shares of saffron and cannot recycle them, so the cost scales with the swarm.
